query: CDC measles cases United States 2025 outbreak surveillance confirmed
query_rationale: Targets the CDC's own measles surveillance or outbreak tracker for 2025. CDC is the primary national authority for confirmed and probable case counts, deaths, and hospitalizations in the US. Removing the rigid exact-phrase wrapper improves recall against CDC page titles and headings that use natural language. Expected to surface the CDC 2025 measles cases page or MMWR outbreak reports.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDC.gov measles surveillance page, MMWR report, or CDC outbreak investigation update with case count table
expected_trust_signal: cdc.gov domain, official CDC authorship, tabular case data with confirmed/probable breakdown

query: measles outbreak 2025 state health department cases confirmed deaths United States
query_rationale: Measles in the US manifests as localized outbreaks investigated by state or local health departments. This query targets state-level official reports that carry subnational_location and locality data — fields that CDC national summaries may not fully disaggregate. Broad enough to surface multiple states (e.g., Texas, Ohio, Florida) that may have reported outbreaks in Q1 2025.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: State health department press release, outbreak investigation page, or situation report naming specific counties or communities with case counts
expected_trust_signal: State .gov domain (e.g., dshs.texas.gov, odh.ohio.gov), official press release language, named outbreak investigation

query: WHO PAHO measles United States 2025 cases situation report outbreak news
query_rationale: WHO Disease Outbreak News and PAHO epidemiological alerts independently report on US measles activity and provide cross-validated case totals. These sources often include cumulative figures, case classification breakdowns, and context on vaccination status — useful for validating CDC numbers and filling deaths/hospitalizations fields. Refined from upstream q_exec_003/004 to use natural phrasing and include both WHO and PAHO.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: WHO Disease Outbreak News entry or PAHO epidemiological alert for measles in the Americas/United States in 2025
expected_trust_signal: who.int or paho.org domain, official situation report format, case count table with date range

query: measles outbreak United States 2025 cases deaths hospitalizations January February March
query_rationale: News coverage of US measles outbreaks in Q1 2025 provides timely locality detail, hospitalization narratives, and dates that official pages may lag. Including 'hospitalizations' and month names improves recall for articles covering specific outbreak events. Refined from upstream q_exec_009/010 to remove the non-functional embedded date-range string and add hospitalization as a term. Established health-beat outlets (AP, Reuters, NPR, STAT News) typically cite official figures directly, making them useful secondary sources for evidence_quote extraction.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: News article from AP, Reuters, NPR, STAT News, or local outlet reporting on a specific US measles outbreak with case counts and location details
expected_trust_signal: Named journalist, citation of CDC or state health department as source, specific case count with date

query: Texas DSHS measles outbreak 2025 confirmed cases Gaines County Lubbock deaths January February March
query_rationale: Texas DSHS is the primary state authority for the dominant Q1 2025 outbreak. The iteration-1 Texas DSHS result (dshs.texas.gov, 1 result) did not surface a detailed snippet with case counts or dates. This query targets DSHS press releases and outbreak investigation pages for Gaines County and Lubbock — the epicenter of the outbreak and site of 2 of the 3 deaths. Including month names improves recall for early-outbreak announcements in January–February 2025.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: Texas DSHS press release or outbreak investigation page with confirmed case count, county-level breakdown, and death/hospitalization data for Q1 2025
expected_trust_signal: dshs.texas.gov domain, official press release language, named county, specific case count with date
previous_iteration_basis: iter1_q1 and iter1_q2 — Texas DSHS appeared once without detailed snippet; deaths in Lubbock need state-level corroboration

query: New Mexico Department of Health measles 2025 confirmed cases Lea County deaths Oklahoma Kansas outbreak
query_rationale: New Mexico DOH and Oklahoma OSDH are the two other primary state authorities for the Southwest outbreak. The Lea County NM adult death needs NMDOH corroboration. Oklahoma's March 11 link (2 cases) needs OSDH press release confirmation. Kansas KDHE may have issued a press release for cases linked to the outbreak. Combining these in one query maximizes recall for the multi-state outbreak's subnational_location and locality fields within the Q1 window.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: New Mexico DOH or Oklahoma OSDH press release or situation update naming Lea County NM death, confirmed case counts, and dates in Q1 2025; Kansas KDHE outbreak notice
expected_trust_signal: nmhealth.org, health.ok.gov, or kdhe.ks.gov domain; official press release language; named county; specific case count with date
previous_iteration_basis: iter1_q2 — NM/OK/KS state-level official pages absent from iteration-1 candidate set; Lea County death and Oklahoma March 11 cases need state-level corroboration
